authors: Jiashun Fu; Xuyang Liu; Wensheng Cai; Haohao Fu; Xueguang Shao

abstract: SpeLL uses LLM and retrieval-augmented generation for NIR spectral data modeling. It has Code RAG for specialized spectral-analysis code and Data RAG for historical spectral datasets, with natural-language interaction, code generation/execution, and Auto-Debug.
